title: Edge connectivity and edge-disjoint paths
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph and let $k$ be a natural number. Then the edge connectivity satisfies $k \le \kappa'(G)$ if and only if, for every pair of distinct vertices $u$ and $v$, the maximum number of pairwise edge-disjoint paths joining $u$ and $v$ is at least $k$.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
quantified over all pairs of distinct vertices u ≠ v
